verdict.rationale: Bitwarden generates standard 30-second TOTP codes [bitwarden-docs-1]. Its Authenticator app syncs with Password Manager only 'once activated' [bitwarden-docs-2] and can import codes from other authenticators [bitwarden-docs-14], which implies a standalone, account-optional path, but no evidence explicitly states that codes generate offline or without an account. The integrated authenticator lives inside an account-based vault and is tied to premium [bitwarden-comm-18], and one user reports TOTP access breaking when Cloudflare blocked their IP [bitwarden-comm-12]. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of offline code generation, explicit confirmation that the Authenticator app works with no account, and hands-on verification of air-gapped use.
